stem: Which quotation from the play best explains Grandpa’s reason for suggesting that he and Cara work on a surprise for Grandma?

options.label: A
options.text: GRANDPA: This is what happens when you ignore something.

options.label: B
options.text: GRANDPA: I have all the supplies we need in the garage.

options.label: C
options.text: GRANDPA: Besides, this is your grandmother’s favorite chair, so it’ll be better than a new chair.

options.label: D
options.text: GRANDPA: Now it will be your turn to choose the color for Grandma’s chair.
